fxhtc_interval.statement: GE OEM FXHTC service interval is 3 months or 30,000 gallons — not 6 months. Independent of FXWPC 3 mo / 16,000 gal.

fxhtc_size_class.statement: FXHTC is a 4.5-inch × 9.625-inch Advanced Replacement cartridge class per GE parts spec.

gxwh20s_cartridge_class.statement: GXWH20S uses 2.5-inch-class replacement elements per GE manual element chart (FXUSC Rev. 2 in-box; alternates FXWPC pleated sediment, FXWTC carbon paper).

gxwh20s_fxhtc_oem_compatibility.statement: GE does not document FXHTC as a GXWH20S replacement element in the GXWH20S manual. GE FXHTC PDP names GXWH40L as filter compatibility. No manufacturer evidence resolves 4.5-inch FXHTC into 2.5-inch GXWH20S housing.

buckparts_interval_six_months.statement: BuckParts ge-fxhtc replacement_interval_months=6 contradicts GE 3 mo / 30,000 gal. This is not correct and must not be retained because baseline expected 3 months — it is incorrect on GE authority.

buckparts_gxwh20s_fxhtc_recommended_mapp.statement: compatibility_mappings ge-whole-house-gxwh20s → ge-fxhtc with is_recommended=true lacks GE fit support and conflicts with 4.5 vs 2.5 inch cartridge classes.

fxhtc_media_copy_only.statement: BuckParts FXHTC display name emphasizes sediment only; GE also documents chlorine taste/odor reduction. Incomplete copy, not the primary sibling-tranche blocker versus interval + GXWH20S fit.

gxwh30c_gxwh35f_gxwh40f_fxhtc_mappings.statement: Other GE model → FXHTC recommended mappings may be valid for larger housings but were not re-adjudicated with housing manuals in this packet. Sibling minimum repair scopes GXWH20S edge only; interval fix is global ge-fxhtc row.

governing_truth.fxhtc: GE FXHTC is a 4.5-inch-class Advanced whole-house replacement filter with OEM service interval 3 months or 30,000 gallons, with chlorine taste/odor reduction and sediment reduction per GE spec. It is not interchangeable with the 2.5-inch GXWH20S element family (FXUSC/FXWPC/FXWTC) documented in the GXWH20S manual.
governing_truth.gxwh20s_fxhtc: Do not recommend or present FXHTC as the primary or recommended fit for GXWH20S without GE evidence. GE does not list FXHTC in the GXWH20S manual element chart.
